info.description: High-performance, fault-tolerant webhook delivery platform with exponential retries, rate limiting, HMAC signing, and dead-letter queues.
info.title: HookOps Webhook Delivery Engine API

post.description: Register a new tenant application and generate an API key (ho_live_...)

get.description: Query delivery logs with optional filtering by status, endpoint ID, date range, and pagination

parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, delivered, failed, dead_letter)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Fetch full forensic details of a delivery attempt including destination HTTP response body

post.description: Reset attempt counter and re-queue a failed or dead-lettered delivery attempt for immediate dispatch

get.description: List all registered webhook endpoints for the authenticated application

post.description: Register a new webhook destination URL and generate an HMAC signing secret (whsec_...)

get.description: Fetch details of a specific webhook endpoint

put.description: Update URL, description, status (active/inactive), or rate limit of an endpoint

delete.description: Delete a webhook endpoint and remove its subscriptions

get.description: List all active event type subscriptions for a specific endpoint

post.description: Subscribe an endpoint to receive events of a specific event type

delete.description: Remove a subscription binding between an endpoint and an event type

get.description: Fetch all event types registered in the authenticated application

post.description: Define a new event type name in dot-notation (e.g. payment.completed)

get.description: Retrieve single event type details by UUID

delete.description: Delete an event type by UUID

post.description: Ingest a webhook event, check idempotency, schedule delivery attempts to subscribed endpoints, and enqueue tasks

get.description: Fetch details of an ingested event by UUID
Fetch all delivery attempts associated with a specific event

post.description: Queue new delivery attempts for an existing event (failed attempts only by default)
Re-queue delivery attempts matching filter criteria (status, endpoint, date range)

get.description: Retrieve aggregated delivery metrics, volumes, success rates, and endpoint health for the application

BearerAuth.description: Enter your API key with the Bearer prefix, e.g. 'Bearer ho_live_...'
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
